title: LASA: Language-Agnostic Semantic Alignment at the Semantic Bottleneck for LLM Safety

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of malicious jailbreak prompts (MultiJail and translated HarmBench datasets) across 10 different languages categorized by resource levels (high, medium, and low-resource) to evaluate the disparity in safety alignment and vulnerability.
